rule.precedence: 1 data availability -> 2 numerical / quantization correctness -> 3 source-checkpoint provenance -> 4 reconstruction and PPL criteria
rule.DATA-BLOCKED: the official file cannot be acquired / parsed, or the frozen extraction policy yields fewer than 128 valid 512-token windows
rule.RUN-BLOCKED: a primary configuration (FR/TR/FC s0-2, EBSS) is missing or invalid (install check, untouched parameters, non-finite or unchanged projections, repeat-evaluation PPL difference != 0, RTN fallback in a C4 baseline), the quantization-pipeline regression (FR s0 on the historical cache) does not reproduce the partial-PPL weights/PPL/reconstruction exactly, the extraction implementation regression or the batch-1 repeatability control fails, or the BF16 PPL differs from 9.237090
rule.OFFICIAL-EBSS-TRANSFER-LIMITED: provenance class != MATCHED-DOCUMENTED (generating checkpoint differs or cannot be established). Takes precedence over the quality classes; the quality class that would otherwise apply is still reported

quality criteria.R (reconstruction gain): EBSS mean expert reconstruction < FR_s and < TR_s for s = 0, 1, 2 AND mean_s RelativePenalty(EBSS, FR_s) <= -0.5 % AND mean_s RelativePenalty(EBSS, TR_s) <= -0.5 %
quality criteria.P (PPL gain): EBSS PPL < FR_s and < TR_s PPL for s = 0, 1, 2 (matched protocol)

rule.notes: FC is a negative control and is not part of R or P. One EBSS set: no EBSS SD is computed; experts are not treated as independent replications.
